title: Comprehensive architecture evaluation and 12-month transformation roadmap
body:
Evaluated ObjectStack's readiness as a universal enterprise software kernel. Analyzed 71 protocol files, 9 core packages, plugin architecture, and ecosystem maturity. Current state: 67% production-ready (Beta). Gap analysis identifies critical infrastructure needs.

## Delivered Artifacts (5 docs, 3,023 lines)

- **EVALUATION_SUMMARY.md** - Navigation hub, quick-start paths for all personas
- **ARCHITECTURE_EVALUATION.md** - 12-dimension scoring, protocol coverage analysis
- **TRANSFORMATION_PLAN.md** - 4-phase roadmap (Q1-Q4 2026), detailed task breakdown
- **TECHNICAL_RECOMMENDATIONS.md** - Protocol/driver/plugin optimization specs, competitive analysis vs Salesforce/ServiceNow
- **IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md** - Prioritized backlog (P0/P1/P2), sprint planning

## Critical Gaps (P0)

| Area | Current | Target | Impact |
|---|:---:|:---:|---|
| Database Drivers | 1 (InMemory only) | 8 | Blocks enterprise adoption |
| Security Protocols | 60% | 95% | Encryption, compliance, masking missing |
| Multi-tenancy | 50% (spec only) | 90% | No working implementation |
| Test Coverage | 72% (51/71 files) | 90% | Quality risk |

## Strategic Recommendations

**Phase 1 (Q1)**: Infrastructure - PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB drivers, encryption protocols, multi-tenant implementation  
**Phase 2 (Q2)**: Enterprise features - GraphQL, Salesforce/Slack connectors, finance/HR/SCM examples  
**Phase 3 (Q3)**: Advanced - Real-time collaboration, AI fine-tuning, observability  
**Phase 4 (Q4)**: Ecosystem - Integration library (20+ connectors), data warehouse, developer certification

## Missing Protocols (Priority)

```typescript
// Critical
packages/spec/src/api/graphql.zod.ts           // GraphQL schema generation
packages/spec/src/system/encryption.zod.ts     // Field-level encryption (AES-256-GCM)
packages/spec/src/system/compliance.zod.ts     // GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA
packages/spec/src/system/cache.zod.ts          // Multi-tier caching (Memory/Redis/CDN)

// High value
packages/spec/src/system/message-queue.zod.ts  // Kafka/RabbitMQ
packages/spec/src/system/search-engine.zod.ts  // Elasticsearch integration
```

## Driver Ecosystem Gaps

Current `InMemoryDriver` lacks filters, sorting, aggregations, transactions. Need production-grade drivers with full `DriverInterface` compliance:

- PostgreSQL (connection pooling, prepared statements, transactions)
- MySQL (AUTO_INCREMENT, ENUM types)
- MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, embedded documents)
- Redis (caching, pub/sub)

Recommend standardized `DriverComplianceTestSuite` to validate all implementations.

## Competitive Position

**vs Salesforce**: At parity on core protocols (Object/Field/Workflow/RBAC). Missing: Platform Encryption, External Lookups, scheduled reports.  
**vs ServiceNow**: Table-driven architecture equivalent. Missing: CMDB, change management, 1000+ integrations.

12-month roadmap targets 95% enterprise feature completeness.
